parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The details of the attack analysis. Valid values:

TOTAL: the number of attacks
TREND: the attack trend
PIE_CHART: Attack Type Distribution
SOURCE_TOP: the top 5 attack sources
CLIENT_TOP: the top 5 attacked assets
DETAILS: the list of attack details

If you set Type to DETAILS, the paging parameters are required
parameters.help_zh:
攻击分析的详情。取值：

TOTAL：攻击次数
TREND：攻击趋势
PIE_CHART：攻击类型分布
SOURCE_TOP：攻击来源TOP 5
CLIENT_TOP：被攻击资产TOP 5
DETAILS：攻击详情列表

当Type取值为DETAILS时，分页参数为必填项
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the attack started. By default, the data of the last 7 days is queried. Unit: seconds.
The start time can only be within the last 40 days
parameters.help_zh:
攻击开始的时间戳，默认查询近7天。单位为秒。
开始时间只能为近40天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the attack ended. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结束的时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

If you set Type to DETAILS, this parameter is required

schema.description_en: The response data for attack analysis

Data.description_en:
The list of attack events. This parameter contains the following fields:

client_url: the URL of the attack request
internetIp: the IP address of the asset instance
instanceName: the name of the asset instance
table_src: the data source
uuid: the UUID of the asset instance
crack_method: the attack request method
crack_hour: the attack time
crack_src_ip: the IP address of the attacker
instanceId: the instance ID
dst_port: the attacked port
client_ip: the attacked IP address
location: the region of the attacker
aliuid: the Alibaba Cloud account ID
crack_cnt: the number of attacks
crack_type: the attack type. Valid values:
    - 113: improper permissions
